name: TextBox 8
text:
Local dashboard for side-scan sonar review

Upload sonar imagery and survey metadata
Condition scans for speckle noise and uneven contrast
Detect crab pots and debris with trained YOLO inference
Show confidence, dimensions and approximate coordinates
Export a field report for cleanup and AUV teams

name: TextBox 8
text:
Input
Side-scan sonar image with location and scale metadata

Image conditioning
Non-local means denoising and CLAHE local contrast normalization

Object detection
Trained YOLO11n model for Crab-Pot and Maybe-Crab-Pot labels

Decision support
Confidence threshold and IoU suppression reduce duplicate boxes

Output
Annotated scan plus JSON and CSV anomaly report

name: TextBox 8
text:
Dataset readiness
The project includes YOLO-formatted training, validation and held-out test splits for two debris classes.

Build readiness
The prototype uses Python, Streamlit, OpenCV and Ultralytics YOLO. A trained best.pt model now resides in the project models folder.

Deployment path
Train or resume on Google Colab GPU, evaluate on held-out test data and run local inference in the dashboard.

Risk control
Operators review low-confidence targets before field action.

name: TextBox 8
text:
Conservation teams can prioritise sonar regions for human review instead of examining full sonar logs manually.

Cleanup and vessel teams receive a structured report containing target class, confidence, dimensions, priority and estimated coordinates.

Local inference supports offshore missions with intermittent connectivity.

Human review remains part of the workflow for ambiguous targets and safety-critical decisions.
